cond_0001.intro: We're looking for an Acquisitions Analyst to join our Principal Real Estate team. In this role, you'll provide analytical support for acquisitions and dispositions in real estate private equity transactions.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Evaluate equity investment opportunities across multiple product types (industrial, apartments, office, retail, and alternatives) using sensitivity analysis, variance analysis, or preliminary valuations of prospective acquisitions/dispositions
Perform due diligence and support the preparation of supporting documentation including presentations and develop written investment committee memos
Develop an understanding of products, programs and clients' needs through available training programs and involvement in ongoing acquisition/disposition activities
Assure quality information reaches laterally between the acquisition/disposition team and the appropriate Asset Manager, including valuation inputs, and other information necessary
Under the direction of senior team members, conduct ongoing research relating to acquisitions, including pricing trends, portfolio construction and related developments to provide quality control of the statistical database
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or equivalent (preference for degrees in finance, mathematics, economics or real estate)
Working knowledge of valuation modeling techniques and valuation software products
Strong quantitative financial background and statistics including basic finance concepts such as time value of money
Self-starter with the ability to work independently
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Ability to quickly and accurately analyze large quantities of information and communicate results, including views on financial and non-financial aspects of transactions
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Preferred Requirements
Real estate experience (including full time or internship experience)
Successfully completed trainee/internship program
Argus Enterprise software knowledge

Evaluate equity investment opportunities across multiple product types (industrial, apartments, office, retail, and alternatives) using sensitivity analysis, variance analysis, or preliminary valuations of prospective acquisitions/dispositions
Perform due diligence and actively contribute to the preparation of supporting documentation including presentations, and communicate findings through written investment committee memos
Develop an understanding of products, programs and clients' needs through available training programs and ongoing involvement in acquisition/disposition activities, staying in regular contact with the team throughout
Ensure quality information flows between the acquisition/disposition team and the appropriate Asset Manager, including valuation inputs and other necessary information — raising issues early and clarifying requirements as they come up
Under the direction of senior team members, conduct ongoing research relating to acquisitions, including pricing trends, portfolio construction and related developments, and communicate results to maintain quality control of the statistical database
cond_0195.requirements:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent (preference for degrees in finance, mathematics, economics or real estate)
Working knowledge of valuation modeling techniques and valuation software products
Strong quantitative financial background and statistics including basic finance concepts such as time value of money
Self-starter
Real estate experience preferred (including full time or internship experience), but not required
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Ability to quickly and accurately analyze large quantities of information and communicate results, including views on financial and non-financial aspects of transactions
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Successfully completed trainee/internship program
Argus Enterprise software knowledge
cond_0195.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0195.values: We value work that is grounded in fairness, responsibility, and concern for others. We believe organizations do their best work when they keep people and impact in view.

People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of real estate valuation and transaction analysis.
cond_0427.responsibilities:
Evaluate equity investment opportunities across multiple product types (industrial, apartments, office, retail, and alternatives) using sensitivity analysis, variance analysis, or preliminary valuations of prospective acquisitions/dispositions
Perform due diligence and support the preparation of supporting documentation including presentations and develop written investment committee memos
Develop an understanding of products, programs and clients' needs through available training programs and involvement in ongoing acquisition/disposition activities
Assure quality information reaches laterally between the acquisition/disposition team and the appropriate Asset Manager, including valuation inputs, and other information necessary
Under the direction of senior team members, conduct ongoing research relating to acquisitions, including pricing trends, portfolio construction and related developments to provide quality control of the statistical database
cond_0427.requirements:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent (preference for degrees in finance, mathematics, economics or real estate)
Working knowledge of valuation modeling techniques and valuation software products
Strong quantitative financial background and statistics including basic finance concepts such as time value of money
Highly motivated and self-starter
Real estate experience preferred (including full time or internship experience), but not required
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Ability to quickly and accurately analyze large quantities of information and communicate results, including views on financial and non-financial aspects of transactions
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Successfully completed trainee/internship program
Argus Enterprise software knowledge
cond_0427.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.

Evaluate equity investment opportunities across multiple product types (industrial, apartments, office, retail, and alternatives) using sensitivity analysis, variance analysis, or preliminary valuations of prospective acquisitions/dispositions
Lead due diligence and drive the preparation of supporting documentation including presentations and investment committee memos
Build a working understanding of products, programs, and clients' needs through available training programs and direct involvement in ongoing acquisition/disposition activities
Ensure quality information flows between the acquisition/disposition team and the appropriate Asset Manager, including valuation inputs and other necessary information
Under the direction of senior team members, execute ongoing research relating to acquisitions, including pricing trends, portfolio construction, and related developments to maintain quality control of the statistical database
cond_0620.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or equivalent (preference for degrees in finance, mathematics, economics, or real estate)
Working knowledge of valuation modeling techniques and valuation software products
Strong quantitative financial background and statistics, including basic finance concepts such as time value of money
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Ability to quickly and accurately analyze large quantities of information and communicate results, including views on financial and non-financial aspects of transactions
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Successfully completed trainee/internship program
Preferred Requirements
Real estate experience (including full-time or internship experience)
Argus Enterprise software knowledge
Self-starter with the ability to work independently
cond_0620.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Evaluate equity investment opportunities across multiple product types (industrial, apartments, office, retail, and alternatives) using sensitivity analysis, variance analysis, or preliminary valuations of prospective acquisitions/dispositions
Perform due diligence and support the preparation of supporting documentation including presentations and develop written investment committee memos
Develop an understanding of products, programs and clients' needs through available training programs and involvement in ongoing acquisition/disposition activities
Assure quality information reaches laterally between the acquisition/disposition team and the appropriate Asset Manager, including valuation inputs, and other information necessary
Under the direction of senior team members, conduct ongoing research relating to acquisitions, including pricing trends, portfolio construction and related developments to provide quality control of the statistical database
cond_0640.requirements:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent (preference for degrees in finance, mathematics, economics or real estate)
Working knowledge of valuation modeling techniques and valuation software products
Strong quantitative financial background and statistics including basic finance concepts such as time value of money
Highly motivated and self-starter
Real estate experience preferred (including full time or internship experience), but not required
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Ability to quickly and accurately analyze large quantities of information and communicate results, including views on financial and non-financial aspects of transactions
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Successfully completed trainee/internship program
Argus Enterprise software knowledge
